arxiv-2009-04461.description: Abstract Abstract Cryptocurrencies (CCs) have risen rapidly in market capitalization over the last years. Despite striking price volatility, their high average returns have drawn attention to CCs as alternative investment assets for portfolio and risk management. We investigate the utility gains for different types of investors when they consider cryptocurrencies as an addition to their portfolio of traditional assets.

arxiv-2311-11430.title: Discreteness effects on the fluxon interaction with the dipole impurity in the Josephson transmission line Journal: Physics Letters A
arxiv-2311-11430.creator: Ivan O. Starodub, Yaroslav Zolotaryuk
arxiv-2311-11430.description: Abstract The influence of discreteness on the fluxon scattering on the dipole-like impurity is studied. This kind of impurity is used to model the qubit inductively coupled to the Josephson transmission line (JTL). The previously proposed fluxon assisted readout process of the qubit state is based on measuring the passage time through the dipole impurity.

arxiv-2409-12776.title: Algorithmic and High-Frequency Trading Problems for Semi-Markov and Hawkes Jump-Diffusion Models
arxiv-2409-12776.creator: Luca Lalor, Anatoliy Swishchuk
arxiv-2409-12776.description: Abstract This paper introduces a jump-diffusion pricing model specifically designed for algorithmic trading and high-frequency trading (HFT). The model incorporates independent jump and diffusion processes, providing a more precise representation of the limit order book (LOB) dynamics within a scaling-limit framework.

arxiv-2601-21970.title: Exact coherent structures as building blocks of turbulence on large domains
arxiv-2601-21970.creator: Dmitriy Zhigunov, Jacob Page
arxiv-2601-21970.description: Abstract Exact unstable solutions of the Navier-Stokes equations are thought to underpin the dynamics of turbulence, but are usually computed in minimal computational domains. Here, we extend this dynamical systems approach to spatially extended turbulent flows featuring multiple interacting ‘substructures’, and show how new simple invariant solutions can be constructed by spatial tiling of exact solutions from small-box calculations.

arxiv-2602-09148.description: Abstract . A growing class of applications depends on fair ordering, where events that occur earlier should be processed before later ones. Providing such guarantees is difficult in practice because clock synchronization is inherently imperfect: events generated at different clients within a short time window may carry timestamps that cannot be reliably ordered.

pmc-11512289.creator: Purna Dwivedi, Mukul Sharma, Afzal Ansari, Arup Ghosh, Subasa C Bishwal, Suman Kumar Ray, Manish Katiyar, Subbiah Kombiah, Ashok Kumar, Lalit Sahare, Mahendra Ukey, Pradip V Barde, Aparup Das, Pushpendra Singh, Marta Giovanetti

pmc-11595532.description: The WISC-V is a widely used scale in clinical and educational settings in Chile. Given that its use guides critical decision-making for children and adolescents, it is essential to have evidence of its psychometric properties, including validity based on internal structure.

pmc-11643259.title: FBLN1 regulates ferroptosis in acute respiratory distress syndrome by reducing free ferrous iron by inhibiting the TGF-β/Smad pathway
pmc-11643259.creator: Yaping Yuan, Youbo Wang, Yufeng Yan, Edward Kim, Jin Bai, Yang Zhao, Qinyun Ma, Wenchao Gu, Haihan Song
pmc-11643259.description: BackgroundAcute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) / acute lung injury (ALI) is a serious medical disease characterized by pulmonary dysfunction and inflammation. This study aims to determine the main molecular modules linked to ARDS and investigate the role of Fibulin-1 (FBLN1) in regulating ferroptosis in ARDS.

pmc-12522731.title: The use of social prescribing and community-based wellbeing activities as a potential prevention and early intervention pathway to improve adolescent emotional and social development: a systematic mapping review
pmc-12522731.creator: Siobhan B Mitchell, Lucy Cartwright, Alex Gude, Alison Bethel, Harriet Hunt, Jane R Smith, Daniel Hayes, Marcello Bertotti, Paul Jarvis-Beesley, Vashti Berry, Kerryn Husk
pmc-12522731.description: BackgroundSocial prescribing (SP) initiatives which aim to connect individuals to community-based assets have received increased research and policy attention, however schemes have mostly centred on adults. There is little research examining how social prescribing might work for children and young people (CYP), and specifically, what pathways into social prescribing look like for this group.

pmc-12587631.title: Neurovascular coupling abnormalities in first-episode drug-naïve major depressive disorder patients
pmc-12587631.creator: Shuyang Cai, Qinger Guo, Xiumei Wu, Yu Fang, Yafei Zhang, Weihua Zhou, Desheng Shang, Tao Chen, Yating Lv, Jinfeng Duan, Hong Yang
pmc-12587631.description: BackgroundMajor depressive disorder (MDD) is currently recognized as the most common and debilitating psychiatric disorder worldwide, while the pathophysiological mechanisms underlying MDD remain unclear. This study aims to investigate neurovascular coupling (NVC) alteration in MDD patients and its correlation with disease severity and sex.MethodsArterial spin labeling and blood-oxygen-level-dependent data were collected from 51 MDD patients and 51 healthy controls (HCs).

pmc-13135433.title: Atypical Presentation of Metformin-associated Lactic Acidosis: A Case Report
pmc-13135433.creator: Elizabeth Welsch, Jerome Evans, Alexander Yoxall, Anna Culhane
pmc-13135433.description: IntroductionMetformin, a first-line type two diabetes medication, is generally considered safe and effective. However, it is rarely associated with life-threatening lactic acidosis. This generally presents in patients with gastrointestinal upset as a primary complaint. It is most common in patients with underlying chronic kidney disease. Prevention of associated mortality requires early diagnosis and intervention with fluids, bicarbonate, vasopressors, and hemodialysis.

pmc-13191493.title: Investigation of the Structural Characteristics and Electrical Conductivity of Natural and Synthetic Coal-Derived Graphitic Carbon
pmc-13191493.creator: Leibo Ji, Kuo Li, Yongshuo Guo, Yongkang Shang, Qinfu Liu
pmc-13191493.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Graphitic carbon is highly valuable due to its versatile applications in industry, and coal-derived graphitic carbon represents a significant and abundant resource. Electrical conductivity is a critical parameter for its performance during utilization. In this study, the carbon structural features and electrical conductivity of both naturally graphitized coal series and synthetic series produced by high-temperature treatment were comparatively studied by using X-ray diffraction (XRD), Raman spectroscopy, high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM), etc.

pmc-13326927.title: Assessing the Impact of an Sexually Transmitted Infections Nurse on the Delivery of Sexually Transmitted Infections/Human Immunodeficiency Virus Services in an Inner-City Emergency Department Using a Human Immunodeficiency Virus/Syphilis Point-of-Care Test During a Syphilis Outbreak in Alberta, Cana

pmc-13554436.title: Gintonin protects hematopoietic stem cells and accelerates bone marrow recovery following cyclophosphamide-induced injury
pmc-13554436.creator: Ajay Vijayakumar, BaiCheng Chen, Jun Hong Park, Seung-Yeol Nah, Jong-Hoon Kim
pmc-13554436.description: Gintonin administration to mice with hematopoietic injury induced by cyclophosphamide (CY) demonstrated that, gintonin promotes hematopoietic recovery as evidenced by restored count of blood cells, alleviated bone marrow suppression and reduced apoptosis of hematopoietic stem cells indicating the potential of gintonin as an adjunct therapeutic agent in chemotherapy.

pmc-13597842.title: Clear aligner therapy among orthodontists in Turkey: practice patterns and comparison with previously reported Iranian findings
pmc-13597842.creator: Ali Borzabadi-Farahani, Hatice Kübra Olkun, Mohammad Behnaz
pmc-13597842.description: ObjectiveThe aim of this paper is to investigate clear aligner therapy (CAT) practice patterns among Turkish orthodontists and compare them with Iranian specialist orthodontists.MethodsA web-based cross-sectional survey of Turkish specialist orthodontists assessed CAT use, adjuncts, training, case selection by malocclusion and age, monitoring and retention protocols, and perceived advantages/disadvantages.

pmc-13647820.title: Working conditions and labour rights coverage of women domestic workers in Peru: a respondent-driven sampling study
pmc-13647820.creator: Janeth Tenorio-Mucha, Christopher Meaney, David Vera-Tudela, Marcolina Infante Ramirez, Sofia Mauricio Bacilio, María de los Ángeles Ochoa Luján, Adelina Díaz Uriarte, Marta Dolorier, Leddy Mozombite Linares, Ernestina Ochoa Luján, Karina Romero, Sebastian Garcia Cruz, Guillermo Almeida-Huanca, Nath
pmc-13647820.description: BackgroundWorldwide, 81% of domestic workers (DWs) lack labour rights due to absent labour-protection laws or a lack of enforcement of existing laws. Paid domestic work is a vital source of employment for women in Latin America, yet most DWs continue to experience precarious working conditions and limited access to labour rights.
